title: Ferrocenyl-based di- and trinuclear lanthanide complexes: solid state structures, (spectro)electrochemical and DFT studies

synthesis.procedure: To a suspension of ferrocenecarboxylic acid 1 (0.41 g, 0.002 mol) in H2O (50 mL) was added a solution of NaOH (0.08 g, 0.002 mol) in H2O (20 mL). The mixture was stirred at 25 °C for 30 min. A solution of [SmCl3·6H2O] (0.00066 mol) in H2O (30 mL) was added dropwise. The reaction mixture was stirred for 1 h and the resulting orange solid was filtered off, washed thoroughly with H2O and dried in air. Crystals suitable for X-ray studies were grown by slow diffusion of Et2O into a DMF solution. Complexes 2–5 were prepared similarly to a reported procedure.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aqueous salt metathesis; crystallization by slow Et2O diffusion into DMF
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Orange solid filtered, washed with H2O, dried in air; crystals grown by slow diffusion of Et2O into a DMF solution.

properties.summary: Described as a paramagnetic lanthanide ferrocenylcarboxylate; no magnetic susceptibility or luminescence data are reported. Characterization is structural, IR, electrochemical and elemental analysis.

source_locations.location: Abstract and solid-state structure discussion of dinuclear 2–5

Orange solid filtered, washed with H2O, dried in air. Crystals grown by slow Et2O diffusion into DMF.

synthesis.procedure: Under anaerobic argon Schlenk conditions, ferrocenecarboxylic acid (1, 0.69 g, 0.003 mol) was dissolved in THF (50 mL) and treated with [Bu4N]OH (1.94 g, 40% in MeOH, 0.003 mol) under stirring at 25 °C for 30 min. Solid GdCl3 (0.00075 mol) was added in a single portion. After stirring 1 h the volume was reduced to ca. 10 mL. Diethyl ether (100 mL) precipitated an orange oil; supernatant was removed and the residue dissolved in THF (20 mL). Crystallization by slow diffusion of diethyl ether. After 5 d, orange crystals were washed with hexane and dried in vacuum.
synthesis.time: 30 min then 1 h stirring; crystals after 5 d
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/vacuum-line under anhydrous argon; slow Et2O diffusion crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Volume reduced to ~10 mL; Et2O (100 mL) precipitated orange oil; residue redissolved in THF (20 mL); slow Et2O diffusion gave orange crystals after 5 d, washed with hexane, dried in vacuum. Packing solvent/[Bu4N]Cl disordered and treated with SQUEEZE.

properties.summary: UV-Vis/NIR spectroelectrochemistry in CH2Cl2 shows ferrocenyl-based absorptions that change on stepwise oxidation; no IVCT between Fc units or coordinated lanthanides is observed. No magnetometry is reported.

measurements.name: UV-Vis/NIR spectroelectrochemistry
measurements.value: spectra recorded from -400 mV to 1300 mV vs Ag/AgCl
measurements.conditions: CH2Cl2, 5.0 mmol L-1 analyte, 0.1 mol L-1 [Bu4N][B(C6F5)4], 25 °C, OTTLE cell (Fig. 7 caption assigns 6)

synthesis.procedure: Same Schlenk procedure as 6: FcCO2H (0.69 g, 0.003 mol) in THF (50 mL) treated with [Bu4N]OH (1.94 g, 40% in MeOH, 0.003 mol), 25 °C, 30 min, then solid TbCl3 (0.00075 mol). Stirred 1 h, concentrated to ~10 mL, Et2O (100 mL) precipitated orange oil, residue redissolved in THF (20 mL), crystallized by slow Et2O diffusion (5 d). Orange crystals washed with hexane and dried in vacuum. Crystal structure also contains refined Et2O and THF.
synthesis.time: 30 min then 1 h stirring; crystals after 5 d
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/vacuum-line under anhydrous argon; slow Et2O diffusion crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Et2O precipitation of orange oil, redissolve in THF, slow Et2O diffusion; crystals washed with hexane and dried in vacuum. Two Et2O and one THF in the asymmetric unit refined for 7.

properties.summary: Neutral 7 shows a UV-Vis band at 440 nm assigned to Tb(III) f–f absorption influenced by FcCO2 units. Spectroelectrochemical oxidation increases intensity at ~440 nm and grows a 630 nm band (mixed-valent Fc oxidation); further oxidation to [7]9+ decreases 445 nm and increases 630 nm. No electron transfer between Fc units or coordinated lanthanides is observed.

measurements.name: UV-Vis absorption λmax (ε) after oxidation to 700 mV
measurements.conditions: applied potential up to 700 mV vs Ag/Ag+; mixed-valent Fc oxidation
